period_note: H1-CUMULATIVE (Jan 1 - Jun 30, 2014), JBL Solo basis. No embedded 'Variance' table exists in either the FY2014 or FY2015 annual report for this bank (confirmed by direct grep of both; this BSEC disclosure only starts appearing in Jamuna Bank's own annual reports from FY2012 for a couple of years and then FY2015 onward, with FY2014 itself a gap) -- sourced instead from the bank's own website interim financial-statement PDF (jamunabankbd.com), 'Half Yearly Position (Un-Audited) as on 30th June, 2014'. That PDF is a scanned image (0 lines from pdftotext) and was OCR'd (pdftoppm 300dpi + tesseract, 10 pages) for this update -- OCR quality was high and every figure below cross-validates exactly against the FY2015 annual report's *own* prior-year (30-Jun-2014) comparative column recovered independently via the rich-PDF path used for 2015_Q2 (e.g. discrete Apr-Jun-2014 net_interest_income of BDT 604.52m matches to the taka; discrete Apr-Jun-2014 interest_income of BDT 2,557.08m matches to the taka) -- two fully independent extractions of the same underlying filing agree exactly, giving high confidence despite the OCR route. A companion 3rd-quarter PDF (fs_sept_14.pdf, a single very dense landscape page combining Consolidated+Solo BS/PL/CF/Equity) was also OCR'd but produced heavily garbled, internally inconsistent numbers (e.g. balance-sheet totals that don't reconcile) even after retrying -- NOT used; 2014 Q3 is left as a genuine gap rather than risk fabricated figures. 2014 Q1 has no corresponding PDF at all on the bank's website archive (its listing starts at Jun 2014) -- also a genuine gap. SOLO section (plain 'BALANCE SHEET (Un-audited)' / 'PROFIT AND LOSS ACCOUNT (Un-audited)' headings, JAMUNA BANK LIMITED) used, not the 'CONSOLIDATED' section earlier in the same document -- matches this dataset's Solo main series (this report's own EPS footnote confirms: 'before consolidation Tk.0.539 per share' vs 'after consolidation Tk.0.543 per share', 0.539 used here). Balance sheet comparative column is 31-Dec-2013 (prior audited year-end): total assets BDT 115,681.64m matches this dataset's stored 2013_Q4.json total_assets (115,162.95m) only approximately (~0.45% different) -- both this 2014 PDF's own Dec-2013 comparative AND the 2013_Q4.json figure trace to the FY2013/FY2015 5-year summary tables respectively, a small pre-existing cross-report difference noted in sources.json, not a new discrepancy introduced here. Foundation contribution rate shown here is 1% of pre-tax profit ('Contribution to Foundation @1% of pre-tax profit'), not the 3% seen in this bank's FY2016+ filings -- profit_after_tax is computed as Total profit before taxes minus (tax provision + Foundation contribution) combined, matching this dataset's annual *_Q4.json convention; the source's own 'Net profit after taxation' line (277,959,960) already equals this computed figure exactly for this particular filing. provision_charge combines 'Provision for loans, advances and others' (700,021,000) and 'Provision for diminution in value in investments' (-2,934,311), the only two provision sub-lines this filing itemizes.
